booking.invalidDates: Enter valid check-in and check-out dates.
booking.past: Check-in cannot be in the past.
booking.missingRoom: Room not found. Please choose again.
booking.occupied: This room is already booked for those dates. Choose another room.

mobile.offline: No connection. Maps and current availability need internet.
mobile.saveFile: Choose Save to Files or a recipient in the iPhone share menu.
mobile.webAuth: Registration and password recovery are not connected in the app API mode yet. Sign in with an existing account; registration uses the web client on the same server.
mobile.bookingLogin: Sign in to request a booking in the app
mobile.localLogout: You signed out on this device. Server session revocation could not be confirmed.
mobile.localHistory: Your history is currently stored only in this app. Create an account to keep it linked to you.
mobile.staffDemoLocal: Password-free demo. Changes stay in this app only. Real staff accounts connect through the server.
mobile.demoWorkspace: Demo · data stays in this app

pricing.periodHint: Set the room-only price per night. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. The base price applies outside these periods. Periods cannot overlap; existing bookings stay unchanged.
pricing.label: Period name
pricing.invalidPeriods: Check the name, dates and whole-number price for each period. Up to 60 periods are allowed.
pricing.overlap: Price periods for a room cannot overlap.
pricing.childCount: Number of children (included in guest count)
pricing.ageHint: Enter completed years at check-in: 0 for an infant. At least one adult is required. All children count towards room capacity.
pricing.invalidChildren: Enter each child’s age from 0 to 17. At least one guest must be an adult.
pricing.childPolicyHint: This removes only this tariff’s supplement for children aged 0–2. The room price remains payable. Extra beds and separate services are not included.
pricing.preview: Estimated price. The server checks current rates on submission and freezes them in the booking.
pricing.baseRoomPrice: base price / night, excluding tariff; dated prices apply after choosing dates
pricing.childrenAtCheckout: Children’s ages and free child tariffs are applied in the booking form.

checkout.commissionHelp: Administrator only. Empty means not configured; 0 means no commission. Applies to new orders.
checkout.refundReconciliation: Refunds require reconciliation of commission and the resort amount.

payment.title: Booking payment
payment.kaspiExplanation: The amount is fixed in your booking. Open the link and pay in Kaspi. Return here after payment: your booking is confirmed when the server verifies the payment.
payment.kaspiUnavailable: Kaspi payment is not connected yet. XPayment access setup is still in progress.
payment.verificationHint: The booking is confirmed after the server verifies payment. Returning to the site does not confirm payment.
payment.cancellationSaved: Booking cancelled. Payment details show the refund status when a refund applies.
payment.explanation: The amount is fixed in your booking. Payment opens on Halyk’s test page. The server verifies payment before confirming your booking. Official test cards only.
payment.hold: Your room is held for {minutes} more min.
payment.unavailable: Bank payment is unavailable: connection setup or verification is incomplete.
payment.paused: Checks on this page have paused. The server continues reconciliation. You can check again.
payment.noReceipt: The payment service receipt is not available on this page yet.

states.pending: Waiting for payment and bank verification.
states.failed: Payment was not completed. Check its status before trying again.
states.expired: Booking expired or cancelled. Do not pay the old link.
states.reconciliation_required: Bank reconciliation required. Do not pay again.

refunds.submitted: The bank is processing the refund.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: Resort receipts, refunds and documents in one workspace.
accounting.scopeHint: Select a resort to configure its company details. Access is limited to your assigned organization.
accounting.totalsHint: Receipts and refunds use financial event dates. These are not profit. Bookings use creation dates.
accounting.documentHint: Draft service acts and invoices are created after recorded checkout. Reviewed copies can be shared with the guest. These are not signed electronic invoices. A cash order remains a draft: a bank payment is not proof of cash received.
accounting.documentLimit: Showing the first 200 documents. Narrow the period to find others.
accounting.companyHint: Enter verified company details and the applicable tax treatment. Publishing freezes the document. Signatures, digital signing and official electronic invoice registration are separate.
accounting.guestHint: Prepared documents appear after the stay and accountant review.
accounting.demoHint: Document preparation and downloads require the Django API.

children.confirm: I confirm the date against the child’s document
children.confirmRequired: Enter and confirm each child’s date of birth.
children.hint: The first 6 digits are only a hint. Verify the date: IIN may not match it. Full IIN is not collected; only age at check-in is stored. Free eligibility depends on the selected rate.
